headline: Warsect transport king
title: Warsect | Barrier Beetle And Transport Worker | Palworld Guide
video_script: Looking for a tough transport Pal in Palworld one point zero? Warsect works Transporting level five and Lumbering level four, plus Planting and Handiwork at level three. Its partner skill, Cast-Iron Shell, gives you a protective barrier after you land five melee hits within five to nine seconds. Wild ones sit around level thirty four to thirty eight. Will you catch Warsect? Comment below!
description: Warsect in Palworld 1.0 works Transporting level five and Lumbering level four and gives a barrier with Cast-Iron Shell.
